title: Users
demo_not_ready: After creating this account, choose Configure sandbox from its user menu. Demo sign-in is enabled only after provisioning.
sandbox_help: Assign an existing shared station. Playback, queue and station settings are shared with the main account. Its entire library and the selected playlists are copied for the demo account, including audio files. Playlist copies can be edited independently.
sandbox_ready: Sandbox ready: {{station}}, songs: {{count}}. Demo sign-in is enabled.
sandbox_saved: The demo library and playlists have been restored. The shared station has not been stopped or reset.
sandbox_reset_confirm: Discard guest changes and restore the saved initial state?
sandbox_replace_warning: Preparing again replaces the demo library and playlists. Reset restores their saved state and removes guest-created playlists, including their references in the shared station. Neither operation resets station settings, clears its queue or stops playback.
subtitle: Manage user accounts and roles.
delete_message: This action cannot be undone. The user will lose access immediately.
